description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing currency settings within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class handles retrieving currency data, updating session and cookie information, and initializing the currency object within the registry.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing and setting the active currency for the session and cookies in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that determines the current currency based on session, cookie, and configuration, and updates session and cookie data accordingly. Also initializes the Currency object in the registry.
